blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Emotion-conditioned text-to-speech (TTS) models may fail to express the requested emotion reliably, and improving controllability by additional training is costly in both computation and emotion-labeled speech training data. We therefore study vector steering, a training-free approach that modifies the internal representations of a frozen model. CoCoEmo, a conventional vector steering method for emotion TTS, treats each emotion vector as an indivisible direction controlled by a single global strength, limiting adherence to the requested emotion. In this work, we first discover that an emotion vector can be decomposed into a shared component that moves speech away from neutral expression and a residual component that directs generation toward the requested emotion. Building on this finding, we propose Emotion Residual-Enhanced Steering for TTS (EmoRES), a novel method that controls the two components without retraining the backbone. On IEMOCAP, EmoRES outperforms CoCoEmo across all four objective emotion metrics on the IndexTTS-2 and CosyVoice2 backbones. Rank correlation improves by 26.13 and 12.97 percentage points, corresponding to relative gains of 118.8% and 33.1%, while emotion hit rate improves by 12.95 and 6.92 points, corresponding to relative gains of 20.1% and 9.8%. Human evaluation further shows a relative improvement up to 35.0% in the rate at which listeners correctly identified the dominant requested emotion and up to a 17.3% improvement in fidelity, while listeners prefer EmoRES for naturalness in up to 63.8% of pairwise comparisons. Component ablations further demonstrate that effective control benefits from preserving the shared component while strengthening the residual of the emotion steering vectors.
blocks.zh: 情感有条件的文字对语音(TTS)模型可能无法可靠地表达所要求的情感,通过额外培训提高可控性在计算和情感标签的语音培训数据上都是代价高昂的. 因此,我们研究矢量引导,这是一种无培训的方法,它改变了冻结模型的内部表述。 CoCoEmo,一种用于情感TTS的常规矢量引导方法,将每个情感矢量视为由单一全球强度控制的不可分割方向,限制了对所请求的情感的坚持. 在这部作品中,我们首先发现一个情感矢量可以分解成一个共享的组件,将语音从中性表达移开,以及一个剩余组件,将生成引向请求的情感. 基于这一发现,我们提出了情感残余-增强TTS指导(EmoRES),这是一种新颖的方法,它控制了这两个部分,而不对骨干进行再培训。 在IEMOCAP上,EmoRES在IndexTTS-2和CosyVoice2主干线上的所有四个客观情感度量表上都超越了CoCoEmo. 排名相关性提高26.13和12.97个百分点,相对增益118.8%和33.1%,而情感冲击率则提高12.95和6.92个百分点,相对增益20.1%和9.8%。 人类评价进一步显示,听众正确识别主导性要求的情绪的速度相对提高了35.0%,忠诚度提高了17.3%,而听众则倾向于在对偶比较中自然性达到63.8%。 组件放大进一步表明,有效控制的好处是保留共享组件,同时加强情感引导载体的剩余部分。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Emotional expression is an important dimension of speech synthesis ( Triantafyllopoulos et al., 2023 ) . Since the same sentence may be spoken with different emotions, TTS systems need to control emotional expression while producing accurate linguistic content. This capability is important for conversational agents ( Chiba et al., 2018 ) , narration ( Liu et al., 2024 ) , accessibility ( Fiannaca et al., 2018 ) , and dubbing ( Cong et al., 2025 ) , where the requested emotion must be conveyed without compromising too much naturalness, intelligibility, or speaker identity ( Xie et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 情感表达是语音合成的一个重要方面(Triantafyllopoulos等人,2023年). 由于同一个句子可能用不同的情绪说话,TTS系统需要控制情绪表达,同时产生准确的语言内容. 这一能力对于对话代理人(Chiba等人,2018年),叙事(Liu等人,2024年),无障碍(Fiannaca等人,2018年),以及杜宾(Cong等人,2025年)来说都很重要,其中所请求的情感必须在不损害太多自然,不通情达理,或演说者身份的情况下传递(Xie等人,2025年).

blocks.en: Existing emotional TTS systems commonly provide control through native conditioning inputs, such as natural-language instructions ( Guo et al., 2023 ; Yang et al., 2025 ; Du et al., 2024 ) or emotion embeddings ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) . These interfaces rely on emotion-aware training or specialized conditioning modules. However, we observe that native emotion conditioning alone does not always generate speech that strongly matches the requested emotion.
blocks.zh: 现有情感 TTS系统通常通过本土调节输入提供控制,如自然语言指令(Guo等人,2023年;Yang等人,2025年;Du等人,2024年)或情感嵌入(Zhou等人,2026年). 这些接口依赖于情感意识训练或专用的调节模块. 然而,我们观察到,仅靠本土情感调节并不总是产生与所请求的情感强烈匹配的演讲.

blocks.en:
Vector steering ( Subramani et al., 2022 ) , a form of activation steering, is an alternative that does not require retraining the model or relying solely on the model’s native conditioning interface. It identifies directions associated with desired behaviors in a model’s internal representations and adds them to the activations during inference, while leaving the model parameters unchanged ( Turner et al., 2023 ; Zou et al., 2023 ; Rimsky et al., 2024 ) . Recent work extends this approach to emotional TTS by extracting directions from the activation differences between emotional and neutral speech ( Xie et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026b ) . These directions can strengthen emotional expression when the embedding or instruction conditioning produces a weak response, while a continuous steering strength controls the steering magnitude.
CoCoEmo ( Wang et al., 2026b ) establishes this approach for modern language-model (LM)-based TTS systems ( Zhou et al., 2026 ; Du et al., 2024 ) . It extracts mean-difference emotion vectors from selected speech LM layers and injects the requested direction at inference time. However, CoCoEmo treats each emotion vector as a single unit governed by one global steering strength. This leaves the structure shared across the emotion vectors unexamined.
blocks.zh:
矢量方向盘(Subramani et al., 2022),是一种激活方向盘的形式,是一种不需要对模型进行再培训或完全依赖模型的本土调节接口的替代品. 它在模型的内部表达中确定与期望行为相关的方向,并在推论中加入激活,同时使模型参数保持不变(Turner等人,2023年;Zou等人,2023年;Rimsky等人,2024年)。 最近的工作通过从情感和中性言论的激活差异中提取方向(谢等人,2025年;王等人,2026年b),将这种方法延伸至情感TTS. 这些方向可以在嵌入式或指令性条件产生弱响应时加强情感表达,而连续的导力则控制着导量.
CoCoEmo(Wang等人,2026年b)为基于现代语言模型(LM)的TTS系统确立了这一方法(周等人,2026年;杜等人,2024年). 它从选定的语音LM层中提取平均偏移的情感向量,并在推论时间注入所请求的方向. 然而,CoCoEmo将每个情感向量作为单一单位,由一个全球方向力所支配. 这使得整个情感向量共享的结构没有经过审查.

blocks.en: In our work, we observe that every categorical emotion vector contains two components: a shared component pointing from the neutral mean toward the centroid of emotional activations, and a residual component pointing from the centroid toward the requested emotion. Conventional steering scales these two components together. This is restrictive because moving speech away from neutral expression and directing it toward a particular emotion need not require the same strength. When stronger category-specific control is needed, increasing the global steering strength also amplifies the shared component. Conventional steering therefore cannot adjust the relative contributions of the two components, which may be suboptimal when they require different strengths.
blocks.zh: 在我们的作品中,我们观察到每一个绝对的情感载体包含两个组成部分:一个来自中性分子的共性成分指向情感激活的中间体,另一个来自中间体的剩余成分指向请求的情感. 常规指导将这两个组成部分结合起来。 这是限制性的,因为将言论从中性表达移开并引导它到特定情感不需要同样的力量. 当需要更强有力的特定类别控制时,增加全球方向力也会扩大共享部分。 因此,常规指导不能调整这两个组成部分的相对贡献,在需要不同优势时,这些贡献可能不够理想。

blocks.en:
In this work, we hypothesize that the shared component primarily moves generated speech away from neutral expression, whereas the residual directs generation toward the requested emotion. Based on this hypothesis, we propose Emo tion R esidual- E nhanced S teering for TTS, or EmoRES-TTS (abbreviated as EmoRES), a novel training-free method that controls the two components independently and enhances the residual steering strength relative to the shared component.
In Section 5.1 , we evaluate EmoRES on IndexTTS-2 ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) and CosyVoice2 ( Du et al., 2024 ) , which use different native emotion-conditioning interfaces. On IEMOCAP, EmoRES strengthens the correlation between the requested emotion proportions and the speech emotion recognizer’s response by 26.13 percentage points for IndexTTS-2 and 12.97 points for CosyVoice2. The rate at which the dominant target emotion receives the largest posterior increase improves by 12.95 and 6.92 points, respectively. Human evaluation shows the same trend. The percentage of clips whose most frequent listener annotation matches the dominant target emotion increases from 54.72% to 73.89% for IndexTTS-2 and from 58.18% to 77.88% for CosyVoice2. EmoRES also obtains statistically significant naturalness preference scores of 63.80% and 60.32% over CoCoEmo on the two backbones.
The component ablations in Section 5.2 further support our hypothesis that the shared component primarily moves speech away from neutral expression, while the residual directs generation toward the requested emotion. Finally, our contributions are as follows: • To our knowledge, we conduct the first functional analysis of the shared component and category-specific residuals in emotion steering vectors for LM-based TTS. • We introduce EmoRES, a training-free generalization of conventional steering that reweights the shared and residual components without learning new subspaces or updating parameters of TTS models.
Experiments across multiple TTS backbones, held-out evaluation, and human judgments consistently demonstrate improved emotional control.
blocks.zh:
在这部作品中,我们假设共享组件主要移动生成的语音脱离中性表达,而剩余部分则引导生成人转向所请求的情感. 基于这一假设,我们提出Emo tion R esidual-E nhanced S teering for TTS,或EmoRES-TTS(缩写为EmoRES),这是一种新颖的无训练方法,它独立地控制了这两个组件,并且相对于共享组件增强了剩余方向力.
在5.1节中,我们评价EmoRES在IndexTTS-2(周等人,2026年)和CosyVoice2(Du等人,2024年)上使用不同的本土情感调节接口. 在IEMOCAP上,EmoRES加强了请求的情感比例与语音情感识别器响应的关联性,在IndexTTS-2和CosyVoice2的12.97分中分别增加了26.13个百分点. 主导目标情感获得最大后期增长的速度分别提高了12.95分和6.92分. 人类评价显示出同样的趋势。 频率最高的听众说明与主流目标情感相符的剪辑百分比从54.72%上升到73.89%的IndexTTS-2,从58.18%上升到77.88%的CosyVoice2。 EmoRES还获得了统计上显著的自然偏好分数,在两个骨干上分别比CoCoEmo获得63.80%和60.32%.
第5.2节的构件进一步支持我们的假设,即共享构件主要使语音远离中性表达,而剩余构件则引导生成人转向所要求的情感。 最后,我们的贡献如下: 据我们所知,我们对基于LM TTS的情感引导载体中的共享组件和特定类别残留进行第一次功能分析。 我们引入了EmoRES,这是常规方向的无培训通用,它重新对共享和剩余组件进行加权,而不学习新的子空间或更新TTS模型的参数.
跨越多个TTS骨干网的实验,被搁置的评价,以及人类的判断,都始终表明情感控制得到了改善.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Emotion-controllable text-to-speech. Emotion-controllable TTS commonly uses categorical labels, continuous emotion embeddings, natural-language instructions, or expressive reference speech. Label-based approaches such as EmoSphere++ ( Cho et al., 2025 ) represent emotion type and intensity in a continuous affective space, while PromptTTS ( Guo et al., 2023 ) and EmoVoice ( Yang et al., 2025 ) use textual descriptions to specify speaking style. Recent zero-shot systems provide similar controls through explicit emotion embeddings, as in IndexTTS-2 ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) , or natural-language instructions, as in CosyVoice2 ( Du et al., 2024 ) . Mixed-emotion synthesis ( Zhou et al., 2022b ) has also been studied using models trained specifically for compound emotional expression. These approaches provide useful control interfaces, but generally depend on emotion-aware training, specialized conditioning modules, or expressive reference signals.
blocks.zh: 情感可控的文字对语音. 情绪可控 TTS通常使用直截了当的标签,连续的情感嵌入,自然语言的指令,或者表达式的参考语. 基于标签的办法,如EmoSphere++ (Cho等人,2025年)在连续的情感空间中代表情感类型和强度,而ExpointTTS(Guo等人,2023年)和EmoVoice(Yang等人,2025年)则使用文字描述来指定说话风格. 近期的零射门系统通过显性情感嵌入提供了类似的控制,如IndexTTS-2(周等人,2026年),或自然语言指令,如CosyVoice2(Du等人,2024年). 混合情感合成(Zhou et al., 2022b)也曾使用专门为复合情感表达而训练的模型进行研究. 这些方法提供了有用的控制界面,但一般依赖于情绪感知训练,专用的调制模块,或表达式参考信号.

blocks.en: Vector steering for speech generation. Vector steering modifies intermediate representations at inference time without updating model parameters. Early work in language models constructs directions from contrasting examples and adds them to internal activations to control high-level behavior ( Turner et al., 2023 ; Zou et al., 2023 ; Rimsky et al., 2024 ) . Related approaches manipulate parameter, speaker, or style embeddings to transfer emotional characteristics in TTS ( Chen et al., 2024 ; de Brito and Junior, 2026 ) . EmoSteer-TTS applies difference-of-means vectors within flow-matching TTS models and supports emotion conversion, intensity control, erasure, and vector composition ( Xie et al., 2025 ) . CoCoEmo instead identifies the speech language model as an effective steering site and combines categorical directions to produce quantitative mixed-emotion speech ( Wang et al., 2026b ) . Subsequent geometric ( Wang et al., 2026a ) analysis finds that speech language model representations provide more separable and speaker-invariant emotion directions than flow-matching representations. Our work adopts this established extraction and inference-time vector steering framework of CoCoEmo ( Wang et al., 2026b ) , but instead examines how categorical directions of emotions are composed and separates the shared displacement from the request-dependent residual.
blocks.zh: 矢量引导用于语音生成. 矢量引导在推论时间修改中间表示,而不更新模型参数. 语言模型的早期工作从对比实例构建方向,并加入内部激活,以控制高层行为(Turner等人,2023年;Zou等人,2023年;Rimsky等人,2024年). 相关方法操纵参数,扬声器,或风格嵌入来转移TTS中的情感特征(Chen等人,2024年;de Brito and Junior,2026年). EmoSteer-TTS在流量匹配的TTS模型中应用不同计量矢量,并支持情绪转换,强度控制,消除,以及矢量组成(Xie等人,2025年). CoCoEmo则将语音模式确定为有效的指导网站,并结合明确的方向,生成定量的混合情绪语音(Wang等人,2026年b). 之后的几何学(Wang et al., 2026a)分析发现,语音语言模型表达法提供了比流比表达法更可分辨和互不相干的情感方向. 我们的工作采用了CoCoEmo(Wang等人,2026年b)的既定提取和推论时间矢量指导框架,但研究情绪的绝对方向是如何构成的,并将共享的流离失所与需求依赖的剩余部分分开。

blocks.en: Composition and representation structure. Existing TTS steering methods construct compound emotions by taking weighted sums of categorical directions ( Xie et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026b ) . This approach treats each direction as an indivisible unit and does not account for structure shared across the emotional vectors. Related work on multi-attribute language-model steering has addressed interference among directions through orthogonal constraints and learned shared and attribute-specific subspaces ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) . Such methods require learning or optimizing new steering subspaces and do not examine the common displacement present in mean-difference emotion vectors. Our proposed EmoRES method instead uses an exact decomposition around the centroid of the emotion-specific mean activations. Under convex composition, the shared component retains a fixed coefficient, while only the residual changes with the requested proportions. EmoRES exposes separate controls for these two components without learning a new subspace or modifying the weights of the TTS backbone.
blocks.zh: 组成和代表结构。 现有的TTS导线方法通过使用绝对方向的加权总和来构造复合情感(Xie等人,2025年;Wang等人,2026年b). 这种方法将每个方向视为一个不可分割的单位,而不计入情感载体共享的结构. 关于多属性语言模式指导的相关工作通过正弦约束和所学的共享和属性特定子空间解决了不同方向之间的干扰(Jiang等人,2025年)。 这种方法需要学习或优化新的引导子空间,而不检查平均偏移情绪矢量中常见的转移。 我们提出的EmoRES方法 使用精确的分解 围绕 情感的中间体 特定的平均激活。 在对流构成下,共享部分保留一个固定系数,而只有剩余变化与要求的比例。 EmoRES在不学习新的子空间或修改TTS主干线的权重的情况下,暴露了对这两个组件的独立控制.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en:
In this work, emotional speech is generated by intervening on the internal activations of a frozen text-to-speech backbone. The procedure is composed of two parts, the emotion vector extraction phase and the vector steering phase.
The remainder of this section specifies the two stages, and then examines the structure of the injected vectors, which admits a decomposition that CoCoEmo ( Wang et al., 2026b ) leaves unexploited and that motivates the proposed method.

本节的其余部分具体说明了两个阶段,然后研究注射矢量的结构,这承认CoCoEmo(Wang等人,2026年b)的分解未开发,并激励了拟议方法.

Steering vector extraction. This is a one-time computation and these vectors are then reused across all utterances for generation during inference. Let h ¯ e \bar{h}_{e} denote that activation averaged over all recordings for each non-neutral emotion e e , and h ¯ neu \bar{h}_{\mathrm{neu}} the mean of the neutral reference activations.
The vector for an emotion is the difference of the two means, v e = h ¯ e − h ¯ neu , v_{e}\;=\;\bar{h}_{e}-\bar{h}_{\mathrm{neu}}, (1) so that v e v_{e} is the average displacement in activation space that separates speech carrying emotion from neutral speech. Extraction requires no gradient computation and no model weight updates.

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en: 4.1 Datasets
blocks.zh: 4.1 数据集

blocks.en: Steering vector extraction. Following the procedure of CoCoEmo ( Wang et al., 2026b ) , all steering directions are extracted from a fixed library of neutral–emotional utterance pairs drawn from three corpora: ESD ( Zhou et al., 2022a ) , CREMA-D ( Cao et al., 2014 ) and RAVDESS ( Livingstone and Russo, 2018 ) . Within a pair the two utterances share both speaker and lexical content, so that the difference between them isolates emotional variation from speaker identity and text content. Both sides of every pair are screened by a speech-emotion-recognition gate and a signal-quality gate, and a pair is discarded whole if either side fails. Partial pairs are never used, since a difference taken between two different sets of utterances would not be a paired contrast. The library spans the four emotions evaluated in this work, namely angry , happy , sad and surprise , with neutral as the reference pole. More experimental details on steering vector extraction can be found in Appendix C .

blocks.en: Evaluation sets. We employ a corpus-level development–test split for evaluation. CREMA-D ( Cao et al., 2014 ) serves as the development set, annotated with per-utterance emotion mixtures over the emotions angry , happy , and sad . All hyperparameter tuning and design choices, including steering coefficients, are conducted exclusively on this corpus. To evaluate out-of-distribution transferability, IEMOCAP ( Busso et al., 2008 ) is strictly held out as the test set, contributing no speakers or recordings to steering vector construction. Annotated with per-utterance mixtures over the emotions angry , happy , surprise , and sad , IEMOCAP assesses whether parameters optimized on the development set transfer effectively across domains.

blocks.en: 4.2 Model steering
blocks.zh: 4.2 示范方向

blocks.en: We evaluate two frozen zero-shot TTS backbones chosen to differ in how emotion is conditioned during inference. IndexTTS-2 ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) is an embedding-conditioned model that takes an explicit emotion embedding as a conditioning input. For IndexTTS-2, we steer layers 1 1 , 6 6 and 8 8 of its semantic language model. CosyVoice 2 ( Du et al., 2024 ) is an instruction-based model that conditions on a natural-language style prompt. For CosyVoice 2, we steer layers 14 14 and 17 17 of its text-to-token language model. Both layer sets are the top- K K most emotion-separable layers published by CoCoEmo ( Wang et al., 2026b ) for these backbones. In both cases, steering is applied at the attention output, which is also the site at which the steering vectors are extracted. No weights are updated and each model’s native emotion conditioning is left at its default, so any measured effect is attributable to the steering vector alone.
blocks.zh: 我们评估了两个冷冻的零射TTS骨干 选择了不同的情感条件 在推论中。 IndexTTS-2(周 al等人,2026年)是一种嵌入式条件模型,采用明显的情感嵌入作为条件输入. 对于IndexTTS-2,我们引导它的语义语言模型的1,1,6,6和8层. CosyVoice 2 (Du et al., 2024)是一种基于指令的模型,以自然语言风格为条件,促进. 对于CosyVoice 2,我们引导它的文本对脚本语言模型的第14,14和17层. 两个层层都是CoCoEmo(Wang等人,2026年b)为这些骨干出版的顶层-K K最情感分离层. 在这两种情况下,引导都应用在注意输出上,这也是引导矢量被提取的地点. 没有更新权重,每个模型的原生情感调节在其默认时被留下,因此任何测量效果都只能归因于方向向量.

( 1 ) at the corresponding layer. Consequently, at a fixed steering strength α \alpha , all steered conditions inject vectors with the same norm and differ only in direction.

blocks.en: 4.3 Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 4.3 评价计量

blocks.en: 4.3.1 Objective evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.3.1 国家 目标评价

blocks.en: We assess emotional expression using target emotion probability ( TEP ) and weighted anchored emotion similarity ( E-SIM ), speaker preservation using speaker similarity ( S-SIM ), and intelligibility using word error rate ( WER ). For mixed-emotion requests, we additionally report Spearman rank correlation ( 𝝆 \bm{\rho} ) and hit rate ( H-Rate ) to measure whether changes in the speech emotion recognizer posteriors follow the requested ordering and dominant emotion. Full definitions and evaluation details are provided in Appendix B.1 .
blocks.zh: 我们使用目标情感概率(TEP)和加权锚定情感相似性(E-SIM)来评估情绪表达,使用扬声器相似性(S-SIM)来保留扬声器,使用词错误率(WER)来评估不显眼性. 对于混合情感请求,我们额外报告斯皮尔曼的等级关联(ρ\bm\rho})和命中率(H-Rate),以衡量语音情感识别器后继器的变化是否遵循请求的顺序和主导情感. 完整的定义和评价细节见附录B.1。

blocks.en: 4.3.2 Subjective evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.3.2 主观评价

blocks.en:
We conduct two human evaluations on IEMOCAP, emotion labeling and naturalness preference. For emotion labeling, annotators listen to one clip at a time and assign the emotion they perceive. The labels collected for each clip form an empirical emotion distribution, from which Dom-hit and Fidelity are computed. For naturalness, annotators listen to outputs from CoCoEmo and our proposed EmoRES method for the same sentence in randomized order and choose whether EmoRES is more natural, CoCoEmo is more natural, or the two sound about the same.
For each subjective evaluation task, each sample received at least 9 annotations from different annotators.
We briefly describe each metric below, with complete definitions and evaluation details provided in Appendix B.2 .

Dom-hit (Dominant emotion hit rate): The fraction of clips whose most frequent annotated emotion label is the utterance’s dominant target emotion. Fidelity: The agreement between the distribution of the annotated emotion labels
over a clip and the target emotion mixture.
Fidelity is sensitive to the whole mixture and therefore penalizes a generated clip that reaches the dominant emotion while suppressing the rest of the requested emotions. Naturalness preference: The tie-adjusted fraction of blind pairwise comparisons in which listeners judged the proposed system more natural than the CoCoEmo baseline. It is an ordinal comparison of two systems rather than an absolute quality score, and it detects a loss of naturalness paid for emotional control.

blocks.en: 4.4 Baselines
blocks.zh: 4.4 基线

blocks.en: We compare against three baselines, all decoded with the same manifests, prompts and frozen backbones. No-steer is the unmodified TTS backbone for emotional speech generation without steering. By default, generation uses each backbone’s native emotion-conditioning interface, namely emotion embeddings for IndexTTS-2 and natural-language instructions for CosyVoice2, unless otherwise specified. This baseline fixes the intelligibility and speaker-identity operating point, and is the reference against which metrics ρ \rho and H-Rate are computed. CoCoEmo ( Wang et al., 2026b ) serves as the emotion vector steering baseline and is recovered exactly at λ c = λ r = 1 \lambda_{c}=\lambda_{r}=1 . Random steer injects an isotropic Gaussian direction at the same layers and site, rescaled to the norm of the vector it replaces, so only the direction changes. It isolates the contribution of the extracted direction from that of the injected magnitude alone, and thus establishes the lower bound that any direction-specific claim must exceed. Results for random steering are provided in Appendix D due to page limitations.

The no-steer baseline uses each original model’s native conditioning, with emotion embeddings for IndexTTS-2 and emotion instructions for CosyVoice2, but without vector steering. Despite this conditioning, its lower TEP and E-SIM relative to the steered systems indicate that native conditioning alone provides weaker alignment with the requested emotions.
Compared with CoCoEmo, EmoRES yields its largest improvements in ρ \rho and H-Rate. On CREMA-D, ρ \rho increases from 25.24% to 45.87% for IndexTTS-2 and from 32.48% to 51.94% for CosyVoice2, while H-Rate increases from 76.00% to 82.49% and from 78.92% to 84.76%, respectively. On IEMOCAP, ρ \rho increases from 22.00% to 48.13% for IndexTTS-2 and from 39.13% to 52.10% for CosyVoice2, while H-Rate increases from 64.34% to 77.29% and from 70.90% to 77.82%, respectively. These results show that changes in the speech emotion recognizer’s posterior more closely follow the requested rank ordering and more often assign the largest increase to the dominant target emotion. TEP and E-SIM also improve in every comparison, indicating higher average posterior mass on the requested emotion set and stronger similarity to the target-weighted emotion anchors. EmoRES further improves S-SIM in every comparison and reduces WER under most settings.

与 CoCoEmo 相比, EmoRES 在 ^ rho 和 H-Rate 中得到了最大的改进 。 在CREMA-D方面,指数TSTS-2从25.24%增加到45.87%,CosyVoice2从32.48%增加到51.94%,H-Rate从76.00%增加到82.49%,从78.92%增加到84.76%。 在IEMOCAP方面,指数TSTS-2从22.00%增加到48.13%,CosyVoice2从39.13%增加到52.10%,H-Rate则从64.34%增加到77.29%,从70.90%增加到77.82%。 这些结果显示,语音情感识别器后部的变化更紧密地遵循了要求的军衔顺序,并且更经常地将最大的增加分配给主导目标情感. TEP和E-SIM在每次比较中也都有所改进,表明在请求的情感集上的平均后质量较高,并且与目标加权情感主锚的强烈相似性. EmoRES在每次比较中都进一步改进了S-SIM,并在大多数设置下减少了WER.

blocks.en:
Table 2 (a) reports the subjective emotion labeling results on IEMOCAP. Without vector steering, the native controls provide weak agreement with the requested emotions, particularly for IndexTTS-2, which obtains a Dom-hit of 17.78% and a Fidelity of 25.04%. Compared with CoCoEmo, EmoRES raises Dom-hit from 54.72% to 73.89% for IndexTTS-2 and from 58.18% to 77.88% for CosyVoice2. Thus, the emotion most frequently identified by listeners matches the dominant target emotion more often under EmoRES. Fidelity increases from 60.05% to 66.32% for IndexTTS-2 and from 50.80% to 59.60% for CosyVoice2.
The improvements in both Dom-hit and Fidelity are statistically significant for both backbones, with paired 95% confidence intervals for the differences between EmoRES and CoCoEmo excluding zero.
The simultaneous improvement in Fidelity shows that the gain in Dom-hit is accompanied by better agreement with the complete target mixture, rather than only stronger expression of its dominant emotion.
These subjective trends align with Table 1 , where EmoRES also improves H-Rate and ρ \rho over CoCoEmo for both models on IEMOCAP.
blocks.zh:
表2(a)报告了IEMOCAP上的主观情感标记结果。 没有向量引导,本地控制对所要求的情绪缺乏一致,特别是IndexTTS-2,它得到17.78%的Dom-hit和25.04%的Fidelity。 与CoCoEmo相比,EmoRES将Dom-hit从54.72%提高到73.89%的IndexTSTS-2,将CosyVoice2从58.18%提高到77.88%. 因此,在EmoRES下,听众最经常发现的情感更经常地与主导目标情感相匹配. IndexTTS-2的童贞率从60.05%增至66.32%,CosyVoice2的童贞率从50.80%增至59.60%。
Dom-hit和Fidelity的改进对两个骨干都具有统计意义,EmoRES和CoCoEmo之间差异的置信间隔为95%,不包括0。
Fidelity同时改进表明,在Dom-hit的增益中,与完全的目标混合物有更好的一致,而不是仅仅更强烈地表达其主导情感.
这些主观趋势与表1一致,其中EmoRES还改进了H-Rate,并且对于IEMOCAP的两种模型,都改进了CoCoEmo。

blocks.en:
Table 2 (b) reports the naturalness comparison between CoCoEmo and EmoRES. EmoRES obtains preference scores of 63.80% for IndexTTS-2 and 60.32% for CosyVoice2.
Both scores are significantly above the 50% indifference point, with 95% confidence intervals of [ 61.70 , 65.91 ] [61.70,65.91] and [ 58.08 , 62.56 ] [58.08,62.56] , respectively.
Overall, the subjective evaluation results indicate that, relative to CoCoEmo, EmoRES improves emotional control while better preserving perceived naturalness.

两个分数都明显高于50%的冷漠点,95%的置信间隔分别为[61.70,65.91] [58.08,62.56] [58.08,62.56].
总体而言,主观评价结果显示,相对于CoCoEmo,EmoRES可以改善情绪控制,同时更好地保存感知的自然性.

blocks.en:
Table 3 isolates the roles of the shared and residual components by holding α \alpha and the steering-vector norm fixed while varying only λ c \lambda_{c} and λ r \lambda_{r} . Shared-only steering improves E-SIM and TEP over no steering, but produces the lowest ρ \rho and H-Rate among the steered conditions for both models. In particular, ρ \rho falls to 5.30% for IndexTTS-2 and 7.20% for CosyVoice2.
As a separate diagnostic, we find that shared-only steering reduces the speech emotion recognizer’s neutral posterior from 36.51% to 7.49% for IndexTTS-2.
Together, these results show that the shared component moves the output away from neutral, but provides imprecise information about the requested emotion mixture.
blocks.zh:
表3通过持有α-α和固定的导师规范而将共享组件和剩余组件的作用隔离开来,而只改变 λ c\lambda_{c}和 λ r\lambda_{r}。 仅限共享方向盘改进了E-SIM和TEP,而不是没有方向盘,但在两种模式的制导条件中产生最小的 ^rho 和 H-Rate 。 特别是,\rho指数为5.3%,CosyVoice2指数为7.20%。
作为独立的诊断,我们发现只有共享方向将语言情感识别器的中性后导从36.51%降低到IndexTTS-2的7.49%.
这些结果加在一起表明,共享组件使输出脱离中性,但提供了所要求的情感混合物的不准确信息.

blocks.en:
Residual-only steering exhibits the opposite pattern. Relative to the conventional setting of CoCoEmo at λ c = λ r = 1 \lambda_{c}=\lambda_{r}=1 , it improves ρ \rho and H-Rate but reduces E-SIM and TEP for both models. Thus, neither component is sufficient alone. The shared component increases posterior mass on the requested emotion set and similarity to the emotion anchors, but carries little information about the requested mixture. The residual provides category-specific contrast, but when used alone yields lower TEP and E-SIM than the combined direction.
Moreover, simply including both components with equal weights remains suboptimal. Retaining the shared component while increasing the relative residual strength to λ r = 3 \lambda_{r}=3 produces the best emotion-control results in the table. Since all conditions are norm-matched, this improvement arises from rebalancing the two components rather than increasing the overall steering magnitude.
blocks.zh:
仅余方向盘显示相反模式。 相对于常规设定CoCoEmo at QQ c = r = 1\lambda _{c}=\lambda _{r}=1,它改进了 ^ rho 和 H-Rate,但减少了两种型号的E-SIM和TEP. 因此,单靠这两个部分是不够的。 共享组件在所请求的情感集上增加后质,并与情感主锚类似,但携带的关于所请求的混合物的信息很少. 残余物提供特定类别对比,但单用后,其TEP和E-SIM的产量低于综合方向。
此外,仅仅包括两个具有同等重量的成分仍然是不理想的。 保留共享组件的同时,将相对剩余强度提高到QQ r = 3\lambda_{r}=3,在表中产生最佳的情感控制效果. 由于所有条件都与规范相符,这一改进来自两个部分的重新平衡,而不是增加总体指导规模。

blocks.en: 5.3 Visualization of speech emotion embeddings
blocks.zh: 5.3 语言情感嵌入的可视化

blocks.en: Figure 2: Emotion2vec embedding t-SNE plots for utterances generated by IndexTTS-2 on the single-emotion CREMA-D subset ( n = 486 n=486 ). Each point is colored by its requested emotion. Values above each panel report the accuracy of probing and the mean cosine silhouette score.
blocks.zh: 图2:IndexTTS-2在单电动CREMA-D子集(n=486n=486)上生成的用于语音的情感2vec嵌入t-SNE图案. 每个点的颜色都是由其要求的情感所决定的. 每个面板上方的数值报告探测的准确性以及平均余弦硅声分数.

blocks.en: The t-SNE plot ( van der Maaten and Hinton, 2008 ) in Figure 2 illustrates how vector steering changes the distribution of generated utterances in the emotion2vec ( Ma et al., 2024 ) embedding space. To quantify emotion-specific organization, we report two complementary measures computed from the emotion2vec embeddings. Probe accuracy is the balanced accuracy of a logistic regression classifier trained to predict the requested emotion, and therefore measures how emotion identity can be recovered from the embeddings. The cosine silhouette score measures within-emotion cohesion relative to separation from other emotions. Values near one indicate compact, well-separated groups, values near zero indicate overlapping groups, and negative values indicate that samples are often closer to another emotion than to their own.
blocks.zh: 图2中的t-SNE地块(van der Maaten和Hinton,2008年)说明了矢量向导如何改变情感2vec(Ma等人,2024年)嵌入空间中生成的语句的分布. 为了量化情感特异性组织,我们报告从情感2vec嵌入物中计算出来的两种补充措施。 探究精度是经过训练用来预测所请求的情绪的逻辑回归分类器的平衡精度,因此可以测量情绪身份如何从嵌入物中恢复. 与与其他情感的分离相比,余弦硅声分数衡量情感内部的凝聚力. 靠近一个值表示紧凑,分离良好的组别,接近零的值表示重叠组别,负值表示样本往往更接近另一个情感而非自身情感.

blocks.en:
The no-steer embeddings in panel (b) exhibit substantial overlap among the requested emotions. Although native conditioning makes emotion identity partially recoverable, as reflected by a probe accuracy of 56.9%, the slightly negative silhouette score indicates that it does not form compact emotion-specific clusters. Shared-only steering in panel (c) produces similar results, with 57.6% probe accuracy and a silhouette score near zero.
In contrast, residual-only steering in panel (d) forms substantially more distinct clusters, achieving 81.4% probe accuracy and a silhouette score of 0.379. This supports the interpretation that the residual component carries the category-specific contrasts between emotions.
blocks.zh:
在(b)面板中的无刺者嵌入在所请求的情感中显示出大量重叠。 虽然原生的调理使情感特性部分可以恢复,如探测精度为56.9%所反映,但略负的Silhouette分数表明它并不形成紧凑的情感特定集群. 在(c)面板中仅共享方向盘产生类似的结果,探测精度达到57.6%,硅声分数接近零.
与此相反,(d)面板中仅余方向盘形成明显更为不同的集群,探测精度达到81.4%,圆筒分数为0.379。 这支持了剩余成分带有情感之间特定类别对比的解释.

blocks.en:
CoCoEmo in panel (e) combines both components but retains some overlap between the emotion clusters. Our EmoRES method in panel (f) strengthens the residual while retaining the shared component, producing the highest probe accuracy of 86.9% and silhouette score of 0.460.
Compared with CoCoEmo in panel (e), EmoRES in panel (f) produces more compact and distinct emotion-dependent clusters. In particular, the sad and happy clusters are more clearly separated under EmoRES.
This visual pattern is consistent with the higher probe accuracy and cosine silhouette score achieved by EmoRES, indicating that the requested emotions are more distinguishable and that utterances sharing the same target are grouped more closely.
These results suggest that strengthening the residual component improves category-specific emotion structure in embedding space.
blocks.zh:
coCoEmo在面板(e)中结合了两个组件,但保留了情感集群之间的一些重叠. 我们在(f)面板中的EmoRES方法在保留共享组件的同时加强剩余部分,产生86.9%的最高探测精度和0.460的硅光分。
与(e)面板中的CoCoEmo相比,(f)面板中的EmoRES产生更紧凑和独特的情感依赖集群. 特别是,在EmoRES下,悲伤和快乐的集群被更明确地分开.
这种视觉模式与EmoRES所达到的更高探测精度和余弦硅声分数一致,表明所请求的情绪更能区分,共享同一目标的言论被更紧密地分组.
这些结果表明,加强剩余部分可改善嵌入空间中特定类别情感结构。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusions and Future Work
blocks.zh: 6. 结论和今后的工作

blocks.en: This work shows that emotion steering vectors contain shared and residual components with distinct functions. EmoRES controls these components independently and strengthens the residual relative to the shared component without fine-tuning. Norm-matched experiments on IndexTTS-2 and CosyVoice2 demonstrate improved emotion control on both CREMA-D and IEMOCAP, with component ablations and human evaluations supporting the proposed interpretation. Future work will extend EmoRES to token-level or segment-level control for emotions that vary within an utterance and test whether the shared-residual decomposition generalizes across additional emotions, languages, speech corpora, and TTS architectures.
blocks.zh: 这项工作表明,情感引导矢量包含具有不同功能的共享和剩余组件. EmoRES独立控制这些组件,并在没有微调的情况下加强相对于共享组件的剩余部分. 关于IndexTTS-2和CosyVoice2的规范实验表明,对CREMA-D和IEMOCAP的情绪控制有所改进,其中组件模拟和人类评价支持拟议的解释。 未来工作将把EmoRES扩展为对在语境中变化的情感的象征级或段级控制,并测试共享-剩余分解是否泛指其他情感,语言,语音公司和TTS架构.

blocks.en:
We construct the emotion-vector library using the extraction procedure introduced by CoCoEmo ( Wang et al., 2026b ) . We retain CoCoEmo’s preprocessing, activation pooling, and steering layers (elaborated in Appendix C.2 ) to ensure that differences between CoCoEmo and EmoRES arise only from the steering rule.
The extraction library contains paired neutral and emotional utterances from ESD ( Zhou et al., 2022a ) , CREMA-D ( Cao et al., 2014 ) , and RAVDESS ( Livingstone and Russo, 2018 ) . Within each pair, the two recordings have the same speaker and linguistic content but differ in emotion. Each recording is checked using the emotion-recognition and signal-quality filters adopted from CoCoEmo. If either recording fails a filter, the complete pair is removed. IEMOCAP is excluded from vector construction and remains held out for evaluation.
For each frozen TTS backbone, we pass every retained recording through the model and cache the activation at the attention output of each selected steering layer. Let ϕ ℓ ​ ( x ) \phi_{\ell}(x) denote the utterance-level activation obtained from recording x x at layer ℓ \ell using CoCoEmo’s pooling procedure. blocks.en: A separate vector is extracted for every emotion, selected layer, and TTS backbone because their activation spaces are not shared. Extraction is performed once with frozen model parameters and requires neither gradient computation nor weight updates. CoCoEmo uses these vectors directly. EmoRES decomposes the same vectors into shared and residual components without constructing a new vector library.

blocks.en:
The emotion vectors are estimated from 8,050 paired emotional–neutral utterances, approximately 12.6 hours of speech counting both sides of every pair, drawn from the three public corpora listed above.
EmoRES is training-free rather than label-free because it uses labeled emotional speech but requires no gradient-based adaptation.
For each backbone, extraction requires one inference pass over the corpus and produces a small set of backbone-specific vectors that is reused for all subsequent generations and evaluation corpora.
In contrast, fine-tuning requires separate optimization and storage of an adapted checkpoint for each backbone.

EmoRES是无培训而非无标签的,因为它使用有标签的情感演说,但不需要基于梯度的适应.

blocks.en: Probe accuracy against steering response. Figure 4 examines whether emotion separability at a layer is associated with its response to vector steering. For each layer, we compare the accuracy of logistic regression and nearest-centroid emotion probes with the TEP obtained when EmoRES is applied only at that layer. blocks.en: For quality control, we included a small set of samples with unambiguous gold-standard labels and discarded all responses from annotators who failed these checks. We evaluated 360 IndexTTS-2 samples and 330 CosyVoice2 samples in both the emotion-labeling and naturalness-preference tasks. Each sample received at least nine independent annotations per task. Table 2 reports results computed from the retained annotations.

blocks.en: We estimate 95% confidence intervals with bootstrap replicates at the sample level. For emotion labeling, the matched CoCoEmo and EmoRES outputs for each sample are resampled together, and the mean paired difference is recomputed for every resample. For naturalness, each comparison and all its retained judgments are resampled as one unit, after which the preference score is recomputed. The reported bounds are the 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of the resulting bootstrap distributions.
blocks.zh: 我们估计95%的置信间隔 与靴子复制的样本水平。 对于情感标签,每个样本的匹配CoCoEmo和EmoRES输出被重印在一起,每个重印的平均值对等差被重刻. 就自然性而言,每次比较及其所有保留判断被重印为一个单位,然后重印优先得分. 所报告的界限是所产生的靴子分布的2.5和97.5百分位数。

blocks.en:
Table 4 evaluates each steering component under three conditions: removed, replaced by a Gaussian control vector, or retained in its measured direction. Before injection, every nonzero steering vector is rescaled to a common reference norm given by the mean norm of the original emotion vector set. This reference is independent of λ c \lambda_{c} and λ r \lambda_{r} , ensuring that differences between rows reflect component composition and direction rather than total steering magnitude. Consequently, the shared-only and residual-only rows are norm-matched endpoints of the same experimental design rather than lower-dose conditions.
Randomization is indicated directly in the coefficient columns. A coefficient written as b ​ rand b\,\mathrm{rand} replaces the corresponding component with a Gaussian vector matched to that component’s per-clip, per-layer norm and then scaled by b b . For example, the condition λ c = 1 \lambda_{c}=1 and λ r = ` ​ ` ​ 3 ​ rand \lambda_{r}=``3\,\mathrm{rand} ” is magnitude-matched to its unrandomized counterpart ( λ c = 1 , λ r = 3 \lambda_{c}=1,\lambda_{r}=3 ) and differs only in the residual direction. When both columns are marked rand \mathrm{rand} , the complete steering vector is replaced by a single Gaussian vector with the same final norm.
blocks.zh:
表4在三个条件下对每个方向组件进行评估:去除,替换为高斯控制矢量,或保留在测量的方向. 在注射前,每个非零方向矢量被重新调整为由原情感矢量集的平均值给出的共同参考规范. 此引用独立于\\ c\lambda\c} 和\ r\lambda\r} , 以确保各行之间的差异反映组件组成和方向, 而不是总的导数 。 因此,仅限共享和仅限剩余行是相同实验设计的规范匹配终点,而不是低剂量条件.
随机化在系数栏中直接表示. 以 b rand b\,\ mathrm{ rand} 写成的系数将相应的元件替换成一个高斯矢量, 匹配该元件的每克, 每层规范, 然后缩放为 b b 。 例如,X= 1\lambda_{c}=1和r= ` 3 Rand\lambda_{r}=``3\,\mathrm{rand}'的条件与它的无随机对应方(X= 1,r= 3\lambda_{c}=1,\lambda_{r}=3)相适应,只在剩余方向上有所不同. 当两个列被标记为朗德\mathrm{rand}时,完整的方向矢量被一个具有相同最终规范的单高斯矢量所取代.

blocks.en: D.1 Residual randomization
blocks.zh: D.1 残余随机化

blocks.en: Replacing the residual component with a norm-matched Gaussian vector substantially degrades all four emotion-control metrics. At λ r = 1 \lambda_{r}=1 , residual randomization reduces ρ \rho from 25.24% to 5.62% for IndexTTS-2 and from 32.48% to 0.78% for CosyVoice2. H-Rate decreases from 76.00% to 69.51% and from 78.92% to 67.57%, respectively, with corresponding reductions in E-SIM and TEP. The contrast becomes larger at λ r = 3 \lambda_{r}=3 . For IndexTTS-2, randomizing the residual reduces ρ \rho from 45.87% to 0.58% and H-Rate from 82.49% to 67.57%. For CosyVoice2, ρ \rho decreases from 51.94% to 4.12% and H-Rate from 84.76% to 68.65%. Because these pairs have the same residual allocation and final steering norm, the gains from residual enhancement cannot be reproduced by an arbitrary direction with the same magnitude.
blocks.zh: 用标准匹配的高斯矢量取代剩余成分,可以大大降低所有四个情绪控制度量。 在 r = 1\ lambda _{r }= 1 时,余随机化将 ë\rho 从 25.24% 降至 5.62% IndexTTS-2, CosyVoice 2 从 32.48%降至 0.78%. H-Rate分别从76.00 %降至69.51%和78.92%降至67.57%,E-SIM和TEP也相应减少. 对比值在 λ r = 3\lambda_{r 3 时变大. 对于IndexTTS-2,随机抽取的残基将ρ(ρ)从45.87%减少到0.58%,H-Rate从82.49%减少到67.57%. 对于CosyVoice2, o\rho从51.94%下降到4.12%,H-Rate从84.76%下降到68.65%. 由于这些对子具有相同的剩余分配和最终的引导规范,从剩余增强中获得的收益不能由同样规模的任意方向复制.

blocks.en: D.2 Shared component randomization
blocks.zh: D.2 共享组件随机化

blocks.en: The shared component also cannot be replaced by a norm-matched Gaussian. Across both residual strengths and backbones, shared randomization consistently reduces E-SIM and TEP. At λ r = 3 \lambda_{r}=3 , replacing the shared component lowers E-SIM from 64.80% to 62.36% and TEP from 39.98% to 34.59% for IndexTTS-2. For CosyVoice2, E-SIM decreases from 74.71% to 71.09% and TEP from 68.80% to 61.63%. The same replacement also reduces ρ \rho and H-Rate at λ r = 3 \lambda_{r}=3 for both backbones.
blocks.zh: 共享组件也不能被规范匹配的高斯琴所取代. 在剩余优势和骨干上,共享随机化不断减少E-SIM和TEP。 在 r = 3\lambda_{r}=3 中,取代共享组件将 E-SIM 由 64.80% 降至 62.36%,在 IndexTTS-2中,TEP从 39.98%降至 34.59%. 在CosyVoice2中,E-SIM从74.71%下降到71.09%,TEP从68.80%下降到61.63%. 同一置换方式还使两根主干线在 r = 3\lambda_{r}=3时的 ^\rho 和 H-Rate 减少.

blocks.en: D.3 Complete randomization
blocks.zh: D.3 完全随机化

blocks.en:
Replacing the complete steering vector with a norm-matched Gaussian vector fails to recover targeted emotion control. For IndexTTS-2, complete randomization produces a ρ \rho of − 0.50 % -0.50\% and an H-Rate of 67.14%. For CosyVoice2, the corresponding values are − 0.94 % -0.94\% and 67.57%.
For both backbones, complete randomization yields E-SIM and TEP at or below the no-steer baseline, while its low ρ \rho and H-Rate show that the perturbation does not follow the requested emotion.
Together, the randomized controls demonstrate that the performance of EmoRES depends on the measured directions of both components. Neither the residual gain nor the shared contribution can be explained by steering magnitude, energy allocation, or an arbitrary perturbation of the hidden state.
blocks.zh:
用规范匹配的高斯矢量取代完整的方向矢量未能恢复目标情感控制. 对于 IndexTTS-2, 完全随机化生成 − 0. 50% - 0.50 +% 的 $\rho 和 H-Rate 的 67.14% 。 CosyVoice2的相应值为−0.94% -0.94\%和67.57%.
对两种骨干来说,完全随机生成E-SIM和TEP在无刺基线或以下,而其低 ^rho 和 H-Rate 显示扰动不遵循请求的情感.
随机化的控件加在一起表明,EmoRES的性能取决于两个组件的测量方向. 无论是剩余收益还是共同贡献,都无法用方向尺寸,能量分配,或者任意扰动隐藏状态来解释.

blocks.en: Appendix E Steering with emotional speech prompts
blocks.zh: 附录E 以情感演讲提示指导

blocks.en:
Table 5 examines whether EmoRES remains effective when the speaker prompt already expresses the requested emotion.
A target-emotion prompt is a recording by the same speaker, on different content, that raters heard as the requested emotion.
Replacing the neutral prompt with a target-emotion prompt substantially improves the E-SIM and TEP of the no-steer condition for both backbones and datasets, confirming that the emotional content of the reference recording provides a useful control signal.
blocks.zh:
表5审查在发言者已经表达所要求的情绪时,EmoRES是否仍然有效。
目标感应提示是同一位演讲者在不同的内容上录制的,评分者听到的是所要求的情感.
用目标感应的瞬间取代中性瞬间,大大改进了主干和数据集的无刺状态的E-SIM和TEP,证实参考录制的情感内容提供了有用的控制信号.

blocks.en: EmoRES nevertheless outperforms CoCoEmo in E-SIM and TEP for every backbone, dataset, and prompt type. With target-emotion prompts, EmoRES raises E-SIM from 75.66% to 80.33% and TEP from 66.40% to 82.24% for IndexTTS-2 on CREMA-D. On IEMOCAP, the corresponding improvements are from 79.36% to 84.54% and from 78.02% to 89.17%. The same pattern holds for CosyVoice2. EmoRES raises E-SIM from 82.10% to 85.54% and TEP from 84.54% to 92.40% on CREMA-D, and from 79.40% to 82.82% and from 80.04% to 87.63% on IEMOCAP. These results show that residual enhancement complements an emotional reference signal rather than merely compensating for a neutral prompt.
blocks.zh: 然而,EmoRES在E-SIM和TEP中,每个主干、数据集和即时类型都超过了CoCoEmo。 EmoRES将E-SIM从75.66%提高到80.33%,将CREMA-D上的IndexTTS-2从66.40%提高到82.24%。 CosyVoice2也有同样的模式。 EmoRES将E-SIM从82.10%提升至85.54%,TEP从84.54%提升至92.40%CREMA-D,从79.40%提升至82.82%,从80.04%提升至87.63%IEMOCAP. 这些结果表明,剩余增强补充了情感参考信号,而不仅仅是补偿中性提示。

blocks.en: Appendix F Steering Without Native Emotion Conditioning
blocks.zh: 附录F 无土著情感条件的指导

blocks.en:
Table 6 evaluates whether residual enhancement depends on the native emotion-conditioning interface of each backbone. Without emotion embeddings or instructions, the no-steer systems obtain substantially lower TEP and E-SIM than the steered systems. Both CoCoEmo and EmoRES improve these
metrics, demonstrating that the extracted directions can provide emotion control without assistance from native conditioning.
blocks.zh:
表6评价残余增强是否取决于每个骨干原生情感调节接口. 在没有情感嵌入或指令的情况下,无刺系统得到的TEP和E-SIM大大低于受舵系统. CoCoEmo 和EmoRES 都改进这些
度量衡,可以证明提取方向可以提供情绪控制,而无需本地条件的帮助.

blocks.en: EmoRES improves E-SIM, TEP, ρ \rho , and H-Rate over CoCoEmo for both backbones and datasets. On CREMA-D, ρ \rho increases from 11.43% to 32.37% for IndexTTS-2 and from 13.93% to 44.62% for CosyVoice2, while H-Rate increases from 70.92% to 78.27% and from 72.11% to 82.05%, respectively. On IEMOCAP, ρ \rho increases from 23.14% to 44.76% for IndexTTS-2 and from 22.08% to 45.45% for CosyVoice2, while H-Rate increases from 62.99% to 73.65% and from 61.98% to 73.39%. These results show that residual enhancement improves alignment with the requested emotion mixture even when steering provides the only explicit emotion control.
blocks.zh: EmoRES为主干和数据集改进了E-SIM,TEP, à\rho,以及H-Rate over CoCoEmo. 在CREMA-D方面,指数TSTS-2从11.43%增至32.37%,CosyVoice2从13.93%增至44.62%,而H-Rate则分别从70.92%增至78.27%和72.11%增至82.05%。 在IEMOCAP中,指数TSTS-2从23.14%增至44.76%,CosyVoice2从22.08%增至45.45%,H-Rate从62.99%增至73.65%,从61.98%增至73.39%。 这些结果表明,残余增强能改善与所请求的情感混合物的配合,即使引导提供了唯一明显的情感控制.

Table 7 reports the held-out IEMOCAP evaluation scored by three different speech emotion recognizers: emotion2vec+ large ( Ma et al., 2024 ) , which is the recognizer used throughout the paper, Qwen3-Omni ( Xu et al., 2025 ) , and the Odyssey 2024 WavLM ( Goncalves et al., 2024 ) model.
The comparison holds everything fixed except the recognizer. We reuse the audio already generated for Table 1 , so the arms, the steering coefficients, the speaker prompts and the five prompt-resample replicates are identical.

表7报道了被搁置的IEMOCAP评价得分的三种不同的语音情感识别器:情感2vec+大(Ma等人,2024年),这是整个论文使用的识别器;Qune3-Omni(徐等人,2025年),以及Odyssey 2024 WavLM(Goncalves等人,2024年)模型.
除了识别器之外,这个比较还保留了一切 我们重用已经为表1生成的音频,所以手臂,方向系数,扬声器提示和五个即时反照镜复制都是一样的.

blocks.en:
Across both backbones, EmoRES outperforms CoCoEmo on TEP, ρ \rho , and H-Rate under every recognizer, yielding improvements in all 18 comparisons.
Despite their different absolute score ranges, all three recognizers produce the same ordering between CoCoEmo and EmoRES.
Because the generated audio and all generation conditions are unchanged across recognizers, this agreement indicates that the improvements in emotional control are not specific to emotion2vec+ large.
blocks.zh:
EmoRES在TEP上的表现优于CoCoEmo,
尽管绝对得分范围不同,但所有三个承认者都在CoCoEmo和EmoRES之间产生相同的订单.
由于生成的音频和所有生成条件在识别器之间没有变化,这个协议表明情绪控制的改善并非专门针对情感2vec+大.
